classification.plainSummary: This is a procedural resolution that sets the rules for how the House of Representatives will debate and vote on three separate pieces of legislation. The three bills address state funding for pregnancy centers, information requirements for pregnant college students, and a federal land withdrawal in Minnesota. This resolution does not itself change policy; it establishes the process for considering the other bills.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
